paper: AlphaAgents: Large Language Model based Multi-Agents for Equity Portfolio Constructions
headline_strategy: GPT-4o AutoGen group chat combining valuation, fundamental, and sentiment equity specialists under risk-neutral or risk-averse prompts to issue BUY/SELL decisions and form equal-weight technology-stock portfolios
portfolio_selection_reason: Risk-neutral multi-agent is the direct combined-agent headline portfolio and its 13 memberships are exactly recoverable from the official TeX source. It is source evidence, not a repeatable formation rule.
common_task_portability: not defensibly backtestable over 1999-2024 because the only recovered holdings were selected once using January 2024 information
missing_headline_objects: author-linked implementation, AutoGen version, group-chat termination and complete scheduling
risk-neutral/risk-averse persona prompts, model snapshot, sampling settings, seeds and retries
Bloomberg news, filing accessions, Yahoo price snapshot, tool code and RAG state
agent recommendations, debate histories, human review, Phoenix evaluations and repeated trials
a point-in-time repeatable rule producing memberships before February 2024
execution timing, prices, corporate actions, costs/slippage and portfolio return arrays

rejected_substitutes.route: Backcast the 13 February-2024-selected tickers through the 1999-2024 JKP calendar
rejected_substitutes.reason: That directly uses future membership information and survivorship, violating the common no-lookahead contract.

rejected_substitutes.route: Hold cash until February 2024 and evaluate only the four-month paper window
rejected_substitutes.reason: A 301-month cash path plus one short one-off decision is not the common repeatable monthly strategy requested by the study.

rejected_substitutes.route: Treat the 15-stock benchmark or individual-agent portfolios as the headline
rejected_substitutes.reason: They are comparators/ablations and do not reproduce the combined multi-agent selection mechanism.

rejected_substitutes.route: Use one of five community implementations
rejected_substitutes.reason: All are unaffiliated and materially change data, models, orchestration, universe, dates, or benchmark.

rejected_substitutes.route: Use the two local AlphaAgents factor proxies
rejected_substitutes.reason: They are M0 narrative translations with invented formulas, deciles, weights and return streams.

result_policy: The exact 2024 membership list is preserved as source-only portfolio evidence, but no common return is assigned. Backcasting it would be lookahead; generic factors or community agents would be a different strategy.
